preregistration: C6 — constructed strategic demand from two opponent families
frozen_before: any C6 opponent profile is implemented or any C6 rollout exists
the_question: Can a small, preregistered opponent mixture induce a genuine preference reversal between two legal team responses, WITHOUT specifying in advance which response should win against which family?

why_this_follows_from_two_negatives.what_c4_closed: no reversal across six legal STATE partitions under this utility
why_this_follows_from_two_negatives.what_c5_closed: no reversal across the 21 opponent pairs of the admitted OP6-OP12 mixture under this utility
why_this_follows_from_two_negatives.the_diagnosis: the existing task supplies actionable corrections without opportunity cost, so one generalist absorbs every improvement and a second policy earns nothing
why_this_follows_from_two_negatives.the_change: stop searching the existing world for a tradeoff and CONSTRUCT one. This is legitimate only because the tradeoff is still DISCOVERED by the scanner, never asserted by the design.
why_this_follows_from_two_negatives.an_observation_that_motivated_the_family: the admitted mixture OP6-OP12 is OP6_TURTLE, OP7_DEEP_FORTRESS, OP8_INTERCEPTOR, OP9_SPLIT_LANE_FEINT, OP10_ESCORT, OP11_BT_BALANCED, OP12_COUNTER. It contains no sustained attacker -- OP5_RUSHER is excluded from the mixture. A roster with no opponent that punishes passivity cannot generate a passivity/aggression tradeoff, which is a plausible mechanical reason C5 found nothing.

design_principle.target: a conflict in INCENTIVES, not a particular (R1, R2) reversal
must_preregister: the mechanical properties of Family A
the mechanical properties of Family B
why those properties create opposing strategic pressure
must_NOT_preregister: that Family A should prefer any named response
that Family B should prefer any named response
any expected direction, magnitude, or identity of the reversal
any hypothesis about which legal response is 'aggressive' or 'conservative'
design_principle.why: naming the winning response in advance would make the scan a confirmation of the design rather than a discovery about the game. The families are built to create tension; the scanner decides whether tension produced a reversal.

family_A.intended_pressure: punishes blue forward commitment by exploiting the home side blue leaves uncovered

mechanical_properties.lock_counter: long — once committed to the counter-attack it does not re-deliberate quickly
mechanical_properties.min_alive_for_defender: set so no agent is held back for defence
mechanical_properties.intercept_block_base: low — it does not contest blue's advance, it trades
mechanical_properties.threat_radius: small — it is not drawn into defending its own half

family_A.mechanism: it declines to contest blue's push and instead races for blue's flag whenever blue's agents are forward. Blue pays for commitment in conceded scores rather than in blocked advances.

family_B.intended_pressure: punishes conservative, home-heavy blue play by applying sustained offensive pressure and denying progress

mechanical_properties.intercept_block_base: high — blue's slow advances are denied
mechanical_properties.intercept_feasibility_ratio: permissive, so it contests marginal intercepts
mechanical_properties.defender_zone_frac: small — defenders sit tight to home and do not roam
mechanical_properties.lock_attacker: long — sustained pressure rather than oscillation

family_B.mechanism: it attacks continuously regardless of what blue does and denies blue's unhurried buildup, so a blue that holds position loses on score rather than on position.

why_these_oppose.statement: Against Family A, forward commitment is expensive because the cost is a conceded score behind you. Against Family B, holding position is expensive because B scores while blue waits and denies blue's slow advances. A single blue commitment level cannot be simultaneously cheap against both.
why_these_oppose.what_this_does_not_assume: that any SPECIFIC legal team response encodes 'commit forward' or 'hold'. The mapping from responses to commitment is unknown and is exactly what the scan may or may not reveal.
why_these_oppose.falsifiable: if the constructed tension is real but no response pair expresses it, C6 returns NO_REVERSAL and the design is abandoned rather than tuned.

stage_1_mechanical_validation.purpose: confirm each family EXPRESSES the intended pressure. No strategy claim, no reversal claim.
stage_1_mechanical_validation.family_A_must_show: counter-attack initiation rate RISES with blue agents_forward; measured, preregistered direction
stage_1_mechanical_validation.family_B_must_show: offensive pressure sustained and NOT conditional on blue commitment; blue advance-denial rate exceeds the OP6-OP12 mixture mean
stage_1_mechanical_validation.fail_action: if a family does not express its intended pressure, its PROFILE may be corrected and Stage 1 re-run. This is engineering, not science: no reversal or utility number exists at Stage 1, and Stage 2 has not been touched.
stage_1_mechanical_validation.hard_boundary: once Stage 2 begins, no profile may change for any reason. A family that fails Stage 2 is abandoned, never retuned.

stage_2_reversal_discovery.scanner: the C5 gated parallel scanner, reused unchanged

inherited_unchanged.statistics: episode-clustered bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 12345, LCB95 = q_0.025
inherited_unchanged.ranking: min(lcb95_A, lcb95_B) descending, then higher min-support, then lexicographic — per C5_RANKING_AMENDMENT.json

stage_2_reversal_discovery.pairs_examined: one family pair (A vs B). Unlike C5's 21, there is a single opponent pair, so the multiplicity is only over response pairs.

stage_3_confirmation.rule: tests only the single top-ranked Stage-2 candidate, under the identical criterion, with no search

C6_PASS.condition: a response pair reverses per the criterion in >=2/3 policies at Stage 2 AND replicates at Stage 3
C6_PASS.establishes: constructed opponent families induce a genuine preference reversal
C6_PASS.does_not_establish: that the demand is routable, or that it matters at task level
C6_PASS.mandatory_next_step: the already-frozen observability test (OBSERVABILITY_TEST_FROZEN.json + OBSERVABILITY_SCOPE_AMENDMENT.json) on its own fresh block, BEFORE any oracle training

C6_NO_REVERSAL.condition: no response pair satisfies the criterion
C6_NO_REVERSAL.meaning: even deliberately opposed opponent families did not produce a reversal in the legal team-response space under this utility
C6_NO_REVERSAL.action: STOP. Do not tune the families, do not add a third family, and do not lower delta. The finding would be that map_a's legal response space is too coarse to express the constructed tension -- which points at the ACTION SPACE, not the opponents, and would require its own preregistration.
C6_NO_REVERSAL.explicitly_prohibited: iterating opponent designs until one passes. Each opponent design gets ONE Stage-2 attempt.

code_safety_requirements.additive_only: C6 profiles are NEW entries. No existing OP5-OP12 profile, alias, or level mapping may be modified.
code_safety_requirements.regression_gate: before any C6 rollout, a test must assert that profile_for_opponent_key returns byte-identical BTProfile objects for OP5-OP12 as on commit 55cf5e7. Any change to an existing profile would silently invalidate G0 training, C3, C4, C5 and every prior artifact.
code_safety_requirements.not_added_to_the_permanent_board: C6A and C6B are experimental fixtures for this preregistration. They are NOT added to run_g0_v2_seed.OPPONENTS and are not OP13/OP14. Promotion to the permanent roster is a separate decision, only if the experiment proves them useful.
code_safety_requirements.training_pool_untouched: no G0 policy is retrained and no training opponent pool changes. The three frozen G0 policies are evaluated against the new families exactly as they are.

prohibited: preregistering which response should win against which family
modifying a family profile after Stage 2 begins
iterating opponent designs until one passes
adding a third family to keep searching
adjusting delta, support minima, replication, or the ranking function
adding C6 families to the permanent opponent board on the strength of this experiment alone
training any oracle before the observability test
claiming a task-outcome tradeoff from a carrier_survival screen proxy
immutability: After any Stage-2 number exists, none of the above may change.
